title: Alternative Firing Workshop with Bob Green
source_quote: Alternative Firing Workshop with Guest Instructor: Bob Green Weekend Workshop Location: Clay Studio Tuition: $375 Join us for an exciting, hands-on pottery workshop focused on alternative firing methods! Explore a variety of dynamic techniques, including Raku & Naked Raku, Saggar firing, and Horse Hair firing. Discover the rich textures and striking crackle effects of the Obvara method, also known as Baltic Raku. October 23-25 REGISTER>
evidence_sentence: The workshop page states participants will explore raku, naked raku, saggar firing, and horse hair firing techniques.
evidence_quote: Explore a variety of dynamic techniques, including Raku & Naked Raku, Saggar firing, and Horse Hair firing.
summary: A weekend workshop (October 23-25) led by guest instructor Bob Green exploring raku, naked raku, saggar, and horse hair firing methods. Students bring their own greenware and bisqueware. Int/Advanced level. $375 tuition.
how_to_join: Register at the link provided on the class page
